approval_evidence.quote: BLA 761137 ... DATING PERIOD The dating period for PADCEV shall be 24 months from the date of manufacture when stored at 2-8 C (page 2 of the approval letter; electronically signed 12/18/2019; page 1 of the PDF is an image with no text layer)

search_log: listed Seagen (CIK 0001060736) filings via data.sec.gov submissions, all forms; 8-K Item 2.02 releases and 10-Q/10-K 2019-2023 parsed for the PADCEV row
2019Q4 read from the prior-year column of the 2020Q4 release (the quarter's own release prints no PADCEV row); the fiscal 2019 10-K prints 244 (thousand) for 2019
Quarter sums agree with the full-year PADCEV figures (2020: 222.4, 2021: 339.9, 2022: 451.4)

Pfizer (CIK 0000078003) Form 8-K Exhibit 99 earnings releases for 2023Q4 and 2024Q1-2026Q2 fetched and the Padcev row read for Worldwide and U.S. columns (10 quarters in the verified companion pfizer_padcev; U.S. column added here)
2023Q4 release prints a Dec 14-31 stub (footnote (i)); no Seagen 2023Q4 report exists (Form 15 filed 2023-12-26), so 2023Q4 is declared unreported
Pfizer FY2025 Form 10-K searched for Padcev: product revenues vs alliance revenues wording and the wholesaler-distribution one-time impact

unreported_quarters.2023Q4: Ownership change Seagen to Pfizer; no full-quarter figure is published. Pfizer completed the acquisition of Seagen on December 14, 2023 and Seagen filed no report for 2023Q4 (last 10-Q is for 2023Q3, Form 15 filed Dec 26, 2023). Pfizer's 4Q23 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/78003/000007800324000017/pfe-12312023xex99.htm) prints Padcev '52' under footnote (i): 'Represents revenues from legacy Seagen products subsequent to the acquisition on December 14, 2023', a December 14-31 stub that is kept out of the series.

reviewed_anomalies.2024Q1: First Pfizer quarter: the source changes from Seagen's 'Net product sales' (U.S.) to the U.S. column of Pfizer's worldwide revenue-by-product table. Pfizer reports Padcev mostly as product revenues (FY2025 Form 10-K: 'except for the majority of revenues for Comirnaty and Padcev, which are included in product revenues'), so the step is a change of reporter, not of territory.
reviewed_anomalies.2025Q3: Pfizer's FY2025 Form 10-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/78003/000007800326000026/pfe-20251231.htm) attributes part of the 2025 Padcev increase to 'a one-time favorable impact associated with transition to a wholesaler distribution model in the U.S.'; the release does not date the effect to a quarter. Kept as printed.

notes: Series continues from Seagen to Pfizer on the U.S. scope. Pfizer prints Padcev in its revenue-by-product table with Worldwide, U.S. and International columns; the U.S. column is used from 2024Q1 so the territory matches Seagen's U.S. net product sales. Pfizer's worldwide line, which adds the International column, is kept as companion pfizer_padcev. Each quarter is read from the release for that quarter. Pfizer's own wording that revenues for Padcev are 'the majority' product revenues leaves open that a small part of the U.S. column is alliance revenue; this is not itemised.
